title: Convolution Parseval identity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\\varphi$ be a probability density on $(\\mathbb F_2)^n$, and let $F:(\\mathbb F_2)^n\\to\\mathbb R$. The uniform average of $(\\varphi*F)^2$ equals $\\sum_{\\gamma\\in(\\mathbb F_2)^n}\\widehat\\varphi(\\gamma)^2\\widehat F(\\gamma)^2$, where convolution is normalized and the Fourier coefficients use the binary characters of the cube.
hypotheses_covered: $\\varphi$ is a pointwise nonnegative function on $(\\mathbb F_2)^n$ with uniform average $1$
